# Theme contract reference

<!-- GENERATED by tools/sync.py from contract/vehicle.slint. Do not edit by hand. -->
<!-- Source: ola-dash-sdk at 6ec26558de87bb24d2188944db944a6bd3b8951d. contract-version 7. -->

The contract is `contract-version: 7`. Themes read `in` properties and invoke the callbacks listed here. The host writes `in` properties. Themes must never assign to them.

Units come from name suffixes: `-kmh` km/h, `-km` km, `-pct` %, `-c` degC, `-a` A, `-v` V. `-1` means not reported yet. Show `--`.

## Header comment of the contract file

> Ola Dash SDK theme contract.
>
> The host app writes `in` properties; themes only read them and may invoke the
> allowlisted callbacks. Rules for changing this file (see docs/contract.md):
> - additive only: never rename or remove a field, enum value or callback;
> - append new enum values at the end;
> - bump `contract-version` and add a line to the history below.
> The host wraps each theme and re-exports these globals, so a theme's main.slint
> only needs to export `Dash`.
>
> History: v2 park, reverse | v3 custom, hyper-available | v4 easy-park |
> v5 VehicleState, Battery, Ride, Navigation, Plugins; -1 = not reported yet |
> v6 overlay-placement, telltale-order, overlay-style, alert-position (optional Dash props),
> trunk-open, Actions.open-trunk | v6 also: lock-style (optional Dash prop, lock screen) |
> v7 Display.night, Vehicle.data-stale, Actions.open-apps, Actions.open-themes

## Enums

### `DriveMode`

`eco`, `normal`, `sport`, `hyper`, `unknown`, `park`, `reverse`, `custom`, `easy-park`

### `VehicleState`

Vehicle power state as reported by the BCM. sleep: locked, ECUs off | idle: woken while locked | park: unlocked, not ready | drive: ready to ride | charging: charger session active.

`unknown`, `sleep`, `idle`, `park`, `drive`, `charging`

### `Regen`

`none`, `coast`, `brake`

### `OverlayPlacement`

Host safety overlay settings. Themes declare these as OPTIONAL `out` properties on their `Dash` component; absent means the host default. See docs/contract.md.

`top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`

### `Telltale`

Telltale kinds, in the host's default order. Append-only.

`left-indicator`, `right-indicator`, `high-beam`, `headlight`, `ready`, `locked`, `side-stand`, `fault`, `charging`

### `AlertPosition`

`center`, `upper`, `lower`

### `LockKeyShape`

Passcode keypad style (optional `lock-style` on Dash). The host draws and handles the keypad; the theme supplies colours and two shape choices only. See docs/themes.md.

`rounded`, `square`, `grid`

### `LockDigits`

Digit drawing for the keypad and clock: sans uses the font, segment uses the host's seven-segment drawing.

`sans`, `segment`

| `left-indicator` | in | `bool` | type default |  | Stay true while the stalk is on; themes do the blinking. |
| `right-indicator` | in | `bool` | type default |  |  |
| `high-beam` | in | `bool` | type default |  |  |
| `headlight` | in | `bool` | type default |  |  |
| `locked` | in | `bool` | type default |  |  |
| `trunk-open` | in | `bool` | type default |  | Seat/trunk latch is open. It closes mechanically when the seat is pressed down. |
| `ready-to-ride` | in | `bool` | type default |  | Same as state == drive; kept for v1 themes. |
| `clock-text` | in | `string` | type default |  | Clock as preformatted text so themes don't do time math. |
| `data-stale` | in | `bool` | type default |  | True when the vehicle parser is gone, or no vehicle data callback arrived for 5 s while in drive; the other values then show the last known state. The host draws its own NO DATA badge either way. |

## `Actions` global

| Member | Direction | Type | Default | Unit | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `open-android-auto()` | callback | | | |  |
| `open-settings()` | callback | | | | The host may ignore this (and open-apps, open-themes) unless the scooter is parked. |
| `open-trunk()` | callback | | | | Ask the host to open the seat/trunk, like the stock dash's trunk button. The host ignores it unless the scooter is unlocked, in Park and at 0 km/h. |
| `open-apps()` | callback | | | | Ask the host to open its apps / theme screens (v7). The host ignores them unless the scooter is parked. |
